28 B 7 D 176 A 8 C 13 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 28 B 7 D 176 A 8 C 13 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 28 × 7 - __**176 ÷ 8**__ + 13 = ?

⇒ __**28 × 7**__ - 22 + 13 = ?

⇒ __**196 **__- 22 __**+ 13**__ = ?

⇒ __**209 - 22**__ = **187.**

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 15 August 2006 is a Tuesday, then what will the day of the week on 7 September 2017 ?
questions.solution: Given: **15 August 2006** was Tuesday. Now, 2006 to 2017 = 11 Years (8 Ordinary Year and 3 Leap Year). And, In 11 Years = 3 Leap years and 8 Ordinary Year. So, 3 Leap Year has 6 odd days, And, 8 Ordinary Year has 8 odd days. Total odd days = 6 + 8 = 14.
